DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩のコースをご案内しましょうか。昨夜の雨で一部の道がぬかるんでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions for a walking route? Last night's rain has left some paths muddy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は布の靴なので、土の道を避けたいです。二十分くらい歩ける舗装路はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 布靴を濡らさないため土道を避け二十分程度の舗装路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm wearing fabric shoes today, so I'd like to avoid dirt paths. Is there a paved route for about twenty minutes of walking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a paved route of about twenty minutes, avoiding dirt paths to keep your fabric shoes dry. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この入口から池の手前までは舗装されています。池を回る道は土の区間が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The path from this entrance to just before the pond is paved. Parts of the path around the pond are still unpaved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池を一周せず、手前で折り返せば靴を汚しにくいのですね。距離はどのくらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池を一周せず手前で折り返す方法と距離を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So turning back before the pond instead of going all the way around would help keep my shoes clean. How far is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm turning back before the pond rather than circling it, and ask the distance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 片道およそ四百メートルです。折返し地点の手前にベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: About four hundred meters each way. There's a bench just before the turning point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 往復八百メートルならよさそうです。ベンチから先が土の道と考えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 往復八百メートルを選びベンチ以降が土道か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Eight hundred meters round trip sounds good. Should I consider the path past the bench to be unpaved?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the eight-hundred-meter round trip and ask whether the path beyond the bench is unpaved. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ベンチの少し先に舗装が終わる線があります。そこを越えず、この道を戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: A little beyond the bench is a line where the paving ends. Don't cross it; come back along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 舗装の切れ目より前で戻ります。雨が降り出したら、途中で入れる屋根はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 舗装の終わり前で戻ると伝え降雨時の屋根を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll turn back before the paving ends. If it starts raining, is there anywhere under a roof along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll turn back before the paving ends and ask about shelter if it rains. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この区間には屋根がありません。雲行きが変わったら、距離にこだわらず入口へ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There's no roof along this stretch. If the weather looks like it's changing, return to the entrance regardless of the distance you've walked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 屋根はないのですね。天気を見ながら歩いて、雨が来そうならすぐ引き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 屋根がないことを理解し天候悪化時はすぐ入口へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: So there's no shelter. I'll watch the weather as I walk and turn back immediately if rain seems likely.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge there's no roof and say you'll return to the entrance immediately if the weather worsens. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 舗装路にも水たまりがありますので、足元に気をつけてお楽しみください。それでは、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: There are puddles on the paved path too, so watch your step and enjoy your walk. Off you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その経路画面について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about that route-search screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人には東川で乗り換えると聞いたのに、画面には東原と出ています。どちらを見ればいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞いた乗換駅と検索画面の駅名が異なることを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend said to change at Higashikawa, but the screen says Higashihara. Which should I follow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the transfer station you were told differing from the station name on the search screen. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅名が似ていますね。友人の最寄り駅は、どちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The station names are similar. Which station is nearest your friend's home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最寄りは南町です。駅名だけ聞いて、途中の駅を取り違えたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の最寄り駅と駅名を取り違えた可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Minamimachi. I only heard the station names, so I may have mixed up one along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your friend's nearest station and say you may have confused the station names. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 南町までの現在の検索結果では、東原での乗換になっています。出発時刻も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The current search result for Minamimachi shows a transfer at Higashihara. Let's check the departure time too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この十時二十分発なら、乗換に何分あるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望列車の乗換時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: For this departure at ten twenty, I'd like to know how many minutes there are to change trains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the transfer time for your preferred train. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示では十二分あります。到着するホームと出発するホームが違うので、構内図もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It shows twelve minutes. The arrival and departure platforms differ, so please look at the station map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きな箱を持っているので、階段を通らずに移動できるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大きな箱を持って階段を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm carrying a large box, so I'd like to check whether I can get between them without using stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain you're carrying a large box and want to avoid stairs. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この図では両方のホームにエレベーターがあります。当日の運行と設備の表示も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This map shows elevators at both platforms. Also check the service and facility notices on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東原で乗り換えて、現地のエレベーター表示に従います。友人にも駅名を訂正して連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した乗換駅と友人への訂正連絡を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll change at Higashihara and follow the elevator signs there. I'll also contact my friend to correct the station name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the confirmed transfer station and that you'll send your friend the correction. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗換駅の名前を確かめられてよかったですね。箱に気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad we've confirmed the transfer station's name. Take care with your box and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請書は、まだ記入途中でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you still filling out the certificate application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不動産会社の案内に「世帯の証明」とあります。私だけの分で足りるか判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 世帯の証明という指示では必要な範囲を判断できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The real estate company's instructions say “proof of household.” I can't tell whether a copy for just me is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the instruction “proof of household” doesn't tell you whose information is required. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その言葉だけでは必要な範囲がわかりません。証明書の正式な名称は書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That wording alone doesn't identify the required scope. Does it give the certificate's official name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名称は住民票ですが、同居している兄の情報も必要なのかは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住民票の名称と兄の情報が必要か不明な点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says certificate of residence, but doesn't say whether information about my older brother, who lives with me, is needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the certificate's name and explain it's unclear whether your older brother's information is needed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人分と世帯全員分では記載の範囲が違います。提出先に、必要な範囲を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: A copy for you alone and one for the entire household include different information. Can you ask the recipient what scope is needed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いま担当者に電話して、誰の情報が必要か聞いてから書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先に電話して必要な人物の範囲を確認すると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to call the person in charge now and ask whose information they need before filling it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to call the recipient and confirm whose information is required. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、確認後にこの欄を記入してください。不要な情報まで出さないよう、ほかの記載項目も尋ねるとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then fill in this section after checking. It would be good to ask about the other entries too, so you don't provide unnecessary information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話で、本人分だけで本籍の記載も不要だと言われました。この二つを選べばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人分と本籍省略という回答に合う選択欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: They told me on the phone that they only need my own details, without my registered domicile. Should I select these two options?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which options match the answer: your own details only, with registered domicile omitted. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その回答に合わせて、本人分と本籍省略の欄を選びます。提出前に内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Following that answer, select the options for yourself only and registered domicile omitted. Check the contents before submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 選んだ欄を見直しました。本人確認のために持ってきた在留カードもお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 選択欄を見直したことを伝え本人確認書類を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've reviewed the options I selected. I'll also show you the residence card I brought to verify my identity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you've reviewed the selected options and show your identification. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりして申請内容を確認します。交付された書類も見直してからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take these and check the application. Please also review the issued document before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手の症状の欄で、書き方に迷っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you unsure how to fill in the section about your hand symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「しびれ」という言葉がわかりません。指先がぴりぴりする感じも、その欄に書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: しびれの意味と指先のぴりぴりする感覚の記入方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't understand the word “shibire.” Does the tingling feeling in my fingertips go in that section too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the meaning of “shibire” and how to record tingling in your fingertips. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ぴりぴりする感じなどを表す言葉です。ご自分の言葉で、感じ方を書いても大丈夫ですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's a word for feelings such as tingling. It's fine to describe how it feels in your own words.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、「右手の指先がぴりぴりする」と書きます。痛みはあまりありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右手の指先の感覚と痛みが少ないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll write “tingling in the fingertips of my right hand.” There isn't much pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the feeling in your right fingertips and that there is little pain. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 始まった時期や、続いているのかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell us when it started and whether it's continuous.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に気づきました。ずっとではなく、何度か繰り返しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 症状に気づいた時刻と繰り返している状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed it yesterday evening. It isn't constant; it's happened several times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say when you noticed the symptoms and that they recur. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経過も記入しましょう。物を持つときなど、困ったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's write down that course of events too. Have you had any difficulty, such as holding things?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝、箸を持ちにくく感じました。これも診察で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箸を持ちにくかったことを診察で伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: This morning, I found it difficult to hold chopsticks. I'd like to mention that during the examination too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to tell the doctor you had difficulty holding chopsticks. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その点を医師に伝えますね。私の説明で、聞き直したいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I'll tell the doctor that. Is there anything in my explanation you'd like me to explain again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「経過」は症状が始まってからの変化という意味ですね。昨日からのことを順番に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 経過の意味を確認し時間順に説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: “Keika” means the changes since the symptoms began, right? I'll explain what has happened since yesterday in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the meaning of “keika” and say you'll explain in chronological order. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その理解で大丈夫です。記入が済んだら診察へご案内しますので、どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's right. Once you've finished writing, we'll take you in for the examination. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 保存したメッセージをお持ちですね。どのような内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a saved message with you. What does it say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚の名前で、今日中にお金を送ってほしいと届きました。でも文章の感じが普段と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚名義の送金依頼が普段の文章と異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a message in my coworker's name asking me to send money today. But the writing feels different from usual.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a money request in your coworker's name is written differently from usual. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手の本人確認はできていますか。送金や返信はしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you verified who sent it? Have you sent money or replied?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ何も送っていません。確認しようとしたら、メッセージ内の番号に電話するよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送金で指定番号への電話を求められたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't sent anything yet. When I tried to check, they told me to call the number in the message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't sent money and were asked to call the specified number. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その番号が本人のものとは限りません。もともと知っている連絡先で確認することを考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: That number may not belong to your coworker. Consider checking through contact details you already know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社で使っている同僚の番号が別にあります。そちらに連絡して、本人からの依頼か聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前から知る同僚の連絡先で本人確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a separate number for my coworker that we use at work. I'll contact that number and ask whether the request is really from them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll verify their identity through your coworker's previously known contact details. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届いた内容と日時は残しておいてください。相手から身分証の写真なども求められましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the content and the date and time it arrived. Did they also ask for a photo of identification or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードの写真も必要だと言われました。その依頼を含めて画面を保存しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在留カード写真の要求も保存していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: They said they needed a photo of my residence card too. I've saved the screen, including that request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you've also saved the request for a residence-card photo. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を送らず、保存した記録をこちらで確認しましょう。本人に連絡がついたら、その結果も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Don't send the photo; let's check the saved records here. Once you've reached your coworker, tell us the result too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同僚に電話したところ、送金も写真も頼んでいないそうです。保存した記録をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同僚が依頼を否定した結果を報告し記録を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I called my coworker, and they said they hadn't asked for either money or a photo. I'll show you the records I saved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report your coworker's denial of the request and present the records. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた情報を整理して相談を受けます。今日はご相談ありがとうございました、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll organize the information you've confirmed and discuss your concern. Thank you for coming in today; get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱の中身を、送り状に記入していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you write the contents of this box on the shipping label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 衣類と小さなライトが入っています。ライトには電池が入ったままですが、先に伝えたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 衣類と電池入りライトを同梱していることを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are clothes and a small light inside. The batteries are still in the light; should I tell you that first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare that the box contains clothes and a light with batteries installed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、電池の種類によって確認事項が変わります。製品の表示や説明書はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, what we need to check depends on the battery type. Do you have the product markings or instruction manual?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱を開ければ表示を見られます。乾電池式だと思いますが、自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電池の表示は確認できるが種類には自信がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the markings if I open the box. I think it uses dry-cell batteries, but I'm not sure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can check the battery markings but aren't sure of the type. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類が不明なまま受付は進められませんので、表示を確認しましょう。送り先は国内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't proceed while the type is unknown, so let's check the markings. Is the destination within Japan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 国内の父の家です。いったんライトを取り出して、電池の表示を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 国内宛てでライトを取り出して表示を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's my father's home in Japan. I'll take the light out for now and check the battery markings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it's a domestic shipment and you'll take out the light to check the markings. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できましたら、電池の種類と本数を教えてください。梱包についてもその後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've checked, tell me the battery type and number. We'll explain the packaging after that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 単三のアルカリ乾電池が二本でした。衣類とは別に包み直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電池の種類と本数を報告し包み直しを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There were two AA alkaline dry cells. I'd like to rewrap the light separately from the clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the battery type and number, and request to rewrap the item. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 種類がわかりましたね。利用するサービスの条件を確認してから、梱包方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Now we know the type. We'll check the conditions for the service you're using before explaining how to package it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件の説明を聞いてから箱を閉じます。品名にもライトと衣類の両方を記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件を聞いてから封をし品名を具体的に書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll close the box after hearing the conditions. I'll list both the light and clothes in the contents field too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll seal the box after hearing the conditions and describe the contents specifically. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらで条件を確認します。発送の準備が整いましたら窓口へどうぞ、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll check the conditions here. Please come to the counter when you're ready to send it. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込依頼人名の欄について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the transfer sender's name field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃の案内に、名前の前に部屋番号を付けるよう書いてあります。私の名前だけだと足りませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃の依頼人名に部屋番号を付ける指定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The rent instructions say to add my room number before my name. Isn't my name alone enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the instruction to add the room number to the sender's name for rent. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先が入金を照合するための指定かもしれません。案内の記入例を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may be for the recipient to match the payment. Can we check the example in the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに「二〇三、氏名」とあります。振込先の口座名ではなく、自分の名義の欄ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記入例を示し受取人名ではなく依頼人名の欄か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it says “203, full name.” So it's my own sender-name field, not the receiving account's name, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the example and confirm it's the sender's name field rather than the recipient's. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、受取人名と依頼人名は別の欄です。依頼人名の変更方法をこの画面で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the recipient's name and sender's name are separate fields. Let's check how to change the sender's name on this screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 変更した後でも、実行前に部屋番号と名前が両方入っているか見直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実行前に部屋番号と氏名を見直せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: After changing it, can I still check that both my room number and name are included before submitting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can review the room number and full name before submitting. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認画面で見直してください。文字数によって末尾が入らない場合は、そのまま実行せずご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Review it on the confirmation screen. If the character limit cuts off the end, don't submit it as it is; ask us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認画面には「二〇三」と名字までしか入りませんでした。名前を省いてよいか管理会社に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 文字数で氏名が入らず管理会社に省略方法を尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The confirmation screen only fits “203” and my family name. I'll ask the management company whether I may omit my given name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the character limit prevents the full name fitting and you'll ask the management company how to shorten it. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 省略の仕方はこちらでは決められません。管理会社の回答を確認してから入力し直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't decide how to shorten it here. Let's enter it again after confirming the management company's answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理会社から指定の短い表記を教えてもらいました。入力し直して、振込先と金額も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定された短い表記へ修正し口座と金額も再確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: The management company gave me a specified shorter form. I'll enter it again and also recheck the recipient account and amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll change it to the specified short form and recheck the account and amount. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認が済んでからお手続きを進めてください。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed only after finishing the checks. Thank you for asking us today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの弁当の金額をご確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the price of this boxed meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: シールに百円とあるので百円の商品だと思いましたが、レジには四百八十円と出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百円の商品と読み違えたシールとレジ金額の差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sticker says one hundred yen, so I thought that was its price, but the register shows four hundred eighty yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the register price and the sticker you misread as a one-hundred-yen price. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このシールは百円引きという意味です。元の価格が五百八十円なので、値引き後は四百八十円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This sticker means one hundred yen off. The original price is five hundred eighty yen, so it's four hundred eighty after the discount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「引き」の字を見落としていました。もう一つの弁当も同じ意味のシールですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引きの字を見落としたことを述べ別のシールの意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I missed the character meaning “off.” Does the sticker on the other boxed meal mean the same thing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you overlooked the character for “off” and ask the meaning of the other sticker. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そちらは二割引きですので、同じ金額を引くものではありません。表示された値引き後の価格をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That one is twenty percent off, so it doesn't subtract the same amount. Please look at the displayed price after the discount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つは買えないので、四百八十円のほうだけにします。もう一つを戻してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入する弁当を一つに絞りもう一つを戻してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can't buy two, so I'll just take the four-hundred-eighty-yen one. Could you put the other one back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose only one boxed meal and ask for the other to be returned. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらでお戻しします。袋はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we'll put it back. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 弁当が傾かないよう、底が広い自分の袋に入れます。支払いは現金でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 底の広い持参袋を使い現金で払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put it in my own wide-bottomed bag so it won't tilt. I'd like to pay in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll use your own wide-bottomed bag and pay in cash. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では四百八十円です。レシートには値引きの金額も印字されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's four hundred eighty yen. The discount amount is also printed on the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五百円をお渡しします。お釣りを受け取ったら、レシートの値引き欄も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五百円を渡しレシートの値引き欄も確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's five hundred yen. After getting my change, I'll check the discount section on the receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over five hundred yen and say you'll also check the discount section on the receipt. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二十円のお返しです。弁当を水平に持って、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's twenty yen change. Keep the boxed meal level and get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園路の工事表示をご覧になっていましたね。行きたい場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the construction notice for the park paths. Is there somewhere you want to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池の周りを少し歩きたいのですが、工事の先へ入ってしまわないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池の散歩で工事区間へ入らない経路を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a short walk around the pond, but I'm worried I might go into the construction area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a pond-walking route that avoids the construction section. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は池の東側の一部が通れません。南側の道を進み、黄色い柵の手前で戻る経路なら工事区間を避けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Part of the pond's east side is closed today. You can avoid the construction by taking the south path and turning back before the yellow fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一周するのではなく、柵の手前から同じ道を引き返すということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一周せず柵の手前から引き返す経路か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So instead of going all the way around, I turn back before the fence along the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the route turns back before the fence without circling the pond. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです。入口までの途中に休憩用のベンチもあります。どのくらいの時間をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. There are also benches for resting along the way back to the entrance. How much time are you thinking of?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 迎えの車が二十分後に来るので、ベンチで休む時間も含めて十五分以内に戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 迎えまでの時間と休憩を含めた帰着希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My ride comes in twenty minutes, so I'd like to be back within fifteen, including time to rest on a bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the time until your ride arrives and when you'd like to be back, including a rest. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩く速さによって変わりますから、池まで行かずにベンチで折り返すこともできます。時計を見ながら調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It depends on your walking speed, so you could also turn back at a bench without going as far as the pond. Adjust your route while watching the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら今日は最初のベンチまでにします。車との待ち合わせは、今いる入口でよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初のベンチで折り返し待ち合わせ入口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then today I'll just go to the first bench. Is this entrance where I am now all right for meeting the car?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to turn back at the first bench and confirm the entrance for meeting your ride. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図ではここが南入口です。お迎えの方にも南入口と伝えて、駐車場所は現地の表示を確認してもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: On the information map, this is the South Entrance. Tell the person picking you up “South Entrance” too, and ask them to check the local signs for parking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 南入口と連絡しました。最初のベンチで休んで、来た道を戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 南入口と連絡したことと戻る経路を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've told them the South Entrance. I'll rest at the first bench and return the way I came.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you've communicated the South Entrance and explain the return route. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 工事の柵には近づかず、ゆっくりお楽しみください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Don't approach the construction fence, and enjoy your walk at your own pace. Off you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札を出られたあとですが、何かお忘れ物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've already left the ticket gates; did you forget something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今降りた列車に、弁当を入れた青い袋を置いてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降りた列車の車内に青い弁当袋を忘れたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left a blue bag with my lunch in it on the train I just got off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report leaving a blue lunch bag inside the train you got off. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 座っていた場所を覚えていますか。網棚に置かれていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember where you were sitting? Had you put it on the overhead rack?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先頭の車両で、進行方向の左側の席です。袋は足元に置きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先頭車両左側の席の足元に置いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the first carriage, on the left facing the direction of travel. I put the bag at my feet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you left it at your feet at a left-side seat in the first carriage. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列車側に問い合わせるため、降りた時刻も控えますね。袋に目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll also note when you got off so we can contact the train staff. Are there any identifying features on the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い猫の絵が付いています。中の弁当箱にはグエンと名前を書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 猫の絵と弁当箱の記名で忘れ物の特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a picture of a white cat. The lunch box inside has the name “Nguyen” written on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the lost item using the cat picture and the name on the lunch box. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴を伝えます。見つかった場合の連絡先をこちらの用紙にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on those details. Please write your contact details on this form so we can contact you if it's found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯番号を書きます。今日中に返事がなくても、ここに戻ったほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯番号を記入し返事がない場合の再訪を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write my mobile number. If I don't hear back today, should I come back here anyway?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write your mobile number and ask about returning if there's no reply. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ確認中の場合もありますので、戻る前にこの問い合わせ先へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We may still be checking, so please contact this inquiry desk before coming back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に電話で確認してから来ます。問い合わせ番号も控えさせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再訪前に電話すると伝え問い合わせ番号を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll call to check before coming. Please let me note the inquiry number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll call before returning and note the inquiry number. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが番号です。お手間をおかけしますが、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the number. Sorry for the trouble, and take care.
